contests.title: Measure Y — Special Parcel Tax for Fire Protection Services
contests.shortTitle: Measure Y — Mesa fire protection parcel tax
contests.summary: Shall the Mesa Community Services District adopt an ordinance establishing annual special parcel tax of up to $500 per developed parcel and up to $250 per undeveloped parcel, with up to a 3.5% annual escalator, raising approximately $64,500 in year one, to fund an Out of Area Service Agreement with the Bishop Fire Protection District providing fire protection and related services, with all funds used locally for these purposes only, continuing until ended by voters, and subject to annual review?
contests.yes: Adopt the special parcel tax for the fire protection service agreement.
contests.no: Do not adopt the special parcel tax.
contests.noShort: Do not adopt the parcel tax.

links.label: Inyo County official sample ballot — Type 2

contests.title: Measure Z — Lone Pine Special Emergency Response Services Tax Reinstatement
contests.shortTitle: Measure Z — Lone Pine emergency response parcel tax
contests.summary: Shall the measure reinstating the Lone Pine Fire Protection District's previously approved $100 parcel tax, originally adopted in 2014 and expired December 31, 2025, be adopted to continue funding Lone Pine Fire Protection District Special Emergency Response Services, generating approximately $80,000 annually for a period of ten years, with all funds remaining under local control?
contests.yes: Reinstate the $100 parcel tax for ten years to fund special emergency response services.
contests.no: Do not reinstate the parcel tax.
contests.noShort: Do not reinstate the parcel tax.
